notes: Column names may vary; the scripts detect common variants.
Mean district altitude and optional centroids.

District climatological flash density. densidad is LEFT-CENSORED: zero means at or below the instrument detection limit, not absence of lightning (190 of 1891 districts). Models impute censored values at LOD_FLASH_DENSITY = 0.412787 (config/config.R); see docs/CODEBOOK.md. Columns prefixed legacy_ are fossils from an earlier project and are read by no script (REP-002).
